answer: The catalog states Mira is creator of Salt Roads; Tomas is translator of Harbor edition; Harbor and Inland are editions of Salt Roads. Tomas is indirectly associated with the work through Harbor. It asserts neither that Tomas created Salt Roads nor any translator for Inland. Shared work association does not transfer translator relationships. These absent assertions do not prove real-world absence.
